record.text:
Drawing on decades of work on trust in news and social media, we propose a multilevel framework separating five levels of trust: content, agent, system, organization, and AI as a societal phenomenon.

And importantly, trust is both compartmentalized and spills over across levels.

When we say we "trust AI," what do we actually mean? That they doubt a specific chatbot answer? The chatbot itself? The model behind it? The company that built it? Or AI as a force in society? 

These are five different things, and we argue that AI trust research has been conflating them.
